messages:
maria-ng: Quick heads-up — CPT region (cpt-1) readiness thread. Need owners for routing policy, KMS keys, DB replica plan, and any infra blockers before we open beta traffic next Tuesday. TL;DR: routing tag, KMS policy, DB lag test, canary domain.

kevin-choi: I can take routing policy. I pushed a draft PR for the policy tag: `residency:cpt` and the egress ACLs. Link: https://git.internal/routing/PR/482 — needs review for inter-region failover.

samir: On DB replication — we need to confirm cross-region replica lag tolerances. Current plan is async replica to avoid write latencies. I can run a full lag test Friday morning. Any SLO numbers we want to target?

leah: For KMS I'm waiting on the security checklist. We need customer key wrapping enabled in the CPT KMS tenant and a key policy that allows vault rotation from ops-role only. I put a template in the infra repo: `infra/kms/cpt-key.tf`.

maria-ng: Thanks. Targets: tail latency SLA unaffected, < 200ms added by routing, DB replica lag < 10s for read-heavy paths (can relax for internal metrics), KMS key rotation allowed but only with approval via CR.

kevin-choi: Routing notes — two items: (1) BGP peering with cloud partner needs org-to-org handshake; partner asked for ASN and allowed prefixes. I put the ASN in the PR. (2) Can we set a canary domain: `cpt-canary.redwood-infer.dev` so we can route 0.5% traffic? Ops-team please confirm cert chain.

ops-bot: Deploy bot triggered: created ticket INF-7892 for CPT peering; assigned to netops. Cert request ID: CERT-3102.

leah: Cert chain OK as long as CA cross-sign is available. I'll file the CSR today. For KMS: note that cross-region decrypt calls will incur egress; estimate ~0.3ms per call on average. Add to cost forecast.

samir: For DB: I will run a synthetic workload (rps ~200) and measure replication tail. If lag spikes > 10s, we switch to read-fallback in app using `X-Prefer-Primary: false` header for non-critical reads. I'll post results into the DB runbook.

maria-ng: Ownership so far: routing = kevin, db = samir, kms = leah. Can someone volunteer for runbook + ops playbook? We need rollback steps for route withdraw and KMS key disable.

kevin-choi: I'll add routing rollback steps to the PR and include route withdraw playbook.

leah: I'll own KMS rollback (disable rotation + emergency policy revert). Adding notes to infra/kms/README.md.

samir: I'll do the runbook for DB and include the lag detection alert threshold + automation runbook (automatic read-fallback via feature flag).

maria-ng: Great. Blockers?

kevin-choi: Waiting on cloud partner to accept peering — they asked for SOC docs. I pinged partner ops earlier. If they don't accept by Friday EOD we delay canary by 48h.

leah: Security wants a quick risk note on cross-region KMS decrypts for PI data. I can draft and tag privacy for review by tomorrow.

samir: Need the test dataset sanitized for the lag runs; @maria-ng can you confirm a subset we can use?

maria-ng: Yes — use `cpt-lag-test-1` dataset in staging (already sanitized). I'll DM the access.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Sat 03:00-04:00 UTC for infra changes. If we need peering flips, mark the ticket.

maria-ng: OK. Action items recap: kevin — push routing PR final + rollback steps; leah — KMS policy + CSR + risk note; samir — DB lag tests + runbook; ops netops — peering acceptance and cert provisioning. If all green, canary target Tue 07:00 UTC. Ping here with status updates. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary schedule noted: 2025-03-18T07:00:00Z (subject to peering + cert).
